families.rationale: Prevent unsupported CSS units from entering configured paths while keeping allowed-value exceptions visible.
families.scope: Added or modified lines in CSS, SCSS, Less, JavaScript, JSX, TypeScript, and TSX files matched by pathPrefixes.
families.evidence: The matched numeric value and unit from the changed line.
families.remediation: Use replacementUnit and scale, or the repository's configured design token.
families.exemption: allowedValues emit the derived -EXCEPTION finding at exceptionSeverity; they are reviewed rather than silently suppressed.

families.scope: Added or modified JavaScript, JSX, TypeScript, and TSX import lines matched by pathPrefixes.
families.evidence: The exact configured module source found on the changed line.
families.remediation: Use the configured repository-approved wrapper or shared package.
families.exemption: Remove the source from forbiddenImports or narrow pathPrefixes; no inline suppression is implemented.

families.rationale: Keep precision-sensitive calculations behind the repository-approved abstraction.
families.scope: Added or modified JavaScript, JSX, TypeScript, and TSX import lines matched by pathPrefixes.
families.evidence: The direct precision-library import source found on the changed line.
families.remediation: Use preferredSymbol from preferredSource, or the repository-approved precision wrapper.
families.exemption: Remove the source from precisionImports or narrow pathPrefixes; no inline suppression is implemented.

families.rationale: Surface newly added application-local utilities that may belong in a shared workspace package.
families.scope: New .ts or .tsx files under apps/application/utils or apps/application/lib.
families.evidence: The basename of the newly added utility file.
families.remediation: Move generic logic to the configured target and import it through importSource.
families.exemption: Disable rules.sharedUtilities.enabled, or retain the warning as reviewed when the utility is application-specific.

families.rationale: Remind maintainers to validate consumers when a shared workspace package changes.
families.scope: Safe changed paths below packages/package-name, with one finding per changed package.
families.remediation: Refresh workspace dependencies when required and validate all consuming applications.
families.exemption: Set rules.packageChangeReminder to false; no per-package suppression is implemented.
